Title: Test next-season PPP forecasts using previous-season data
Linked work: Relates: SCRUM-476; Relates: BSR-41; Relates: BSR-42; Relates: BSR-43; Relates: BSR-44; Relates: BSR-45; Relates: BSR-46; Relates: BSR-56; Relates: BSR-80; Relates: BSR-82; Relates: BSR-83; Relates: BSR-102; Relates: BSR-105; Relates: BST-157; Relates: BST-163; Relates: BST-164; Relates: BST-165; Relates: BST-166; Relates: BST-167; Relates: SCRUM-603
Description:
Test PPP forecasts using only information available before each prediction, then compare them with later results that were not used to build the model.
This follows [SCRUM-476](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-476). The current calibration report uses a fixed Ridge model, trains on earlier seasons, and evaluates a later season. However, it also uses statistics from the season being evaluated, so it does not prove pre-game forecasting accuracy. This task adds a separate forecasting evaluation.
To complete this task:
* Define when the prediction is made and how far ahead it predicts. Record when every input would have been available.
* Build the inputs from earlier information only. Do not use future games, future seasons, or the results being predicted.
* Reserve later data for the final test. Use only earlier data to choose features and model settings and to fit scaling or other data preparation steps.
* Compare the forecast model with a baseline that follows the same timing rules, using the same untouched test rows. Report prediction errors, calibration, sample counts, and limitations.
* Add tests showing that changing future data cannot change earlier prediction inputs or data preparation fitted on earlier training data.
* Document the test procedure and code and dataset versions so someone else can reproduce the results.
Comments:
I scheduled this for Iteration 15, October 6–12, with the existing 3-point estimate. It is still To Do.
The current calibration report checks historical results using some same-season statistics. This task will use only information available before each prediction and a separate later dataset to evaluate future forecasting.

Finished the separate season-ahead PPP evaluation using prior-season inputs and a final season kept out of model selection. The model's improvement over the league baseline is small and its bias is higher, so this does not establish reliable pre-game accuracy. [Results and limits](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ba814406a69c6de23f14af06a28f153eaa436fdc/docs/iteration-15/forecast/README.md), [code](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/commit/3a8b00b3d1114172285df668cb5a0c91553dcb58) and [passing CI](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/actions/runs/38345252833).

This chart compares the held-out season with the two baselines. Ridge improved slightly over the league baseline. The report keeps the season split, row-level predictions and limitations.
